item.title: Cornell president says school "must do better" amid investigation criticism
item.description: Cornell's president said the administration "must do better" amid criticism of its investigation into allegations by a former student.

item.title: FlyDubai captain recounts struggle after attack on Tel Aviv flight
item.description: The Indian pilot attacked by his co-pilot on a FlyDubai flight spoke about the incident and his response on Saturday.

item.title: Archive: Ken Kesey and the Merry Pranksters
item.description: In 1964, writer Ken Kesey and his Merry Pranksters set out on a cross-country counterculture road trip in a psychedelic bus.

item.title: Senior Trump officials meet at Camp David to discuss Iran war
item.description: Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth were among officials meeting Friday to discuss a path forward.
